changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' as it's not an NLG task being evaluated (timeline generation is an intermediate step). Added MAVEN-ERE dataset mentioned in experiments. Normalized task names and model names.
Consolidated duplicate 'Temporal Inconsistency' metrics into a single normalized form.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. LLMs are used for generation only.
No human evaluation of generated outputs is conducted in this paper. Human annotation was only used for dataset creation (OmniTemp).

overall_notes: This paper focuses on temporal relation extraction using LLMs for generating complete temporal graphs. While it involves natural language generation (timeline summaries and graph generation), the primary task is structured prediction rather than traditional NLG. The paper uses automatic metrics (F1 and Temporal Inconsistency) but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation of the generated outputs.
